comparison.objective: Recover a crawler around an obstacle using only its tether; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable tether routing and remote pulling versus rigid tool use, rotary adjustment, locking, and impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Crawler in zone without wall contact or tipping versus quantified non-bottoming carriage stops. Zone/tip thresholds are omitted.
comparison.reason: The candidate is a rigid mechanical commissioning task, unlike tether-mediated recovery.
